United Nations S/RES/2599 (2021) Security Council Distr.: General 30 September 2021

Resolution 2599 (2021) Adopted by the Security Council at its 8870th meeting, on 30 September 2021

The Security Council, Recalling its resolution 1970 (2011) and all its subsequent resolutions on Libya, including resolutions 2259 (2015), 2510 (2020), 2542 (2020) and 2570 (2021), Recalling its determination in its resolution 2213 (2015) that the situation in Libya continues to constitute a threat to international peace and security,

1. Decides to extend until 31 January 2022 the mandate of the United Nations Support Mission in Libya, as an integrated special political mission to carry out its mandate, as set out in resolution 2542 (2020) and paragraph 16 of resolution 2570 (2021);

2. Decides to remain actively seized of the matter.

21-13916 (E) *2113916*
